chapters.title: The Wet Map
chapters.objective: Lin must obtain Bo's dry map from Aunt He's tea stall before Yan's witnesses reach the flooded market, while concealing the lantern and deciding whether to tell Bo what opening it costs.
chapters.conflict: Bo will not leave unless Lin promises to protect Mei.
chapters.state_change: Lin learns the bridge will close earlier because of the flood.
chapters.hook: A river voice repeats a promise in Lin's own voice.

chapters.title: Archive Stairs
chapters.objective: Lin and Bo reach the archive stairwell, give Mei the map, and force Mei to reveal why Yan's sister was placed inside the lantern's debt record before the second bell.
chapters.conflict: Mei refuses to reveal the ledger entry while Bo is present.
chapters.state_change: Mei confirms the debt was transferred by an archivist, not the guild.
chapters.hook: Yan sends a bargain written in water across the map.

chapters.title: Third Bell
chapters.objective: Lin confronts Yan at the bridge with the sealed lantern and the ledger proof, chooses between exposing Mei's past transfer or saving Bo from the rising flood, and ends with a concrete unresolved cost.
chapters.conflict: Yan offers Lin the erased debt in exchange for the lantern before the third bell.
chapters.state_change: The group learns whose memory will be erased if the lantern opens.
chapters.hook: The third bell begins to ring as the lantern seal cracks but does not open.

chapters.title: Cracked Seal
chapters.objective: Lin carries the cracked but unopened lantern into the closing market while Mei identifies the endangered memory and Yan decides whether to honor the bridge boundary.
chapters.conflict: The cracked seal leaks fragments of a shared childhood that none of them can safely claim.
chapters.state_change: Yan agrees to suspend collection until the memory owner is found.
chapters.hook: Bo recognizes a street in the leaked memory that does not exist on his map.

chapters.title: The Missing Street
chapters.objective: Bo leads the group through the flooded market to locate the impossible street while Lin tests whether the leaked memory belongs to her or Mei.
chapters.conflict: Aunt He blocks the route because the missing street exposes her former work for the guild.
chapters.state_change: Aunt He admits she transported the original debt record years ago.
chapters.hook: The river gate repeats a promise in Aunt He's voice naming a hidden archive.

chapters.title: Underwater Archive
chapters.objective: Lin and Mei enter the hidden archive before the flood destroys it, while Bo and Yan keep the exit open and compare the old debt index with the current ledger.
chapters.conflict: The archive can be entered only by speaking a promise that the river will preserve.
chapters.state_change: They find proof that the debt was split between two names rather than transferred once.
chapters.hook: One of the two names has been erased from every surviving record.
must_avoid: revealing the erased name without evidence

chapters.title: The Erased Name
chapters.objective: Mei reconstructs the erased name from physical traces while Lin and Yan disagree over whether restoring it would return the debt to an innocent person.
chapters.conflict: Yan wants certainty before the flood destroys the evidence; Mei refuses to guess.
chapters.state_change: The group proves the erased person voluntarily accepted half the debt.
chapters.hook: The recovered signature matches Lin's cut-palm courier mark.

chapters.title: Courier's Mark
chapters.objective: Lin investigates why her mark appears on a record older than her courier service while Bo tests the map against the archive's physical layout.
chapters.conflict: The evidence suggests Lin lost an earlier memory before the story began.
chapters.state_change: Lin accepts that she was present at the original sealing but still does not know her choice.
chapters.hook: A sealed side ledger contains a message addressed to Lin in her own handwriting.

chapters.title: Before Dawn
chapters.objective: Lin reads her old message and prepares a lawful public hearing while Yan's guild allies arrive to seize the lantern before dawn.
chapters.conflict: The message offers a legal path that requires Lin and Yan to disclose their private bargains publicly.
chapters.state_change: Lin and Yan choose testimony over secret debt erasure.
chapters.hook: The guild witnesses challenge the archive's authority as dawn light reaches the bridge.

chapters.title: Salt at Dawn
chapters.objective: At the public hearing, Lin presents the map, ledger, promises, and cracked lantern, forcing a ruling on the split debt while preserving a concrete unresolved memory cost.
chapters.conflict: The guild accepts the evidence only if someone assumes responsibility for the damaged seal.
chapters.state_change: The debt collection is suspended and the lantern remains sealed under joint custody, but Lin's missing memory is not restored.
chapters.hook: After the ruling, the river repeats one final sentence in the erased person's voice.
